name: saucerswap-limit-orders
description: Keeperless limit and stop-loss orders on SaucerSwap V2, guarded by Chainlink and executed by the Hedera Schedule Service.

steps.label: Start the frontend (it uses the live testnet vault)
Import or generate a deployer account, fund it from the faucet
Deploy your own vault to Hedera testnet (about 25 HBAR)

steps.text: There is no local chain: the vault needs Hedera's Schedule and Token Services. README.md has the proofs, costs and troubleshooting.
